_source: sokkan-cloud branch main (293573d), written by tests/fixtures/gateway_contract/regenerate.py: `usage` is the `GET /usage` example of infer/pilote-etude.md § 4, verbatim but for `study.study_id`, replaced by a neutral identifier (tests/fixtures/gateway_contract/neutral.py, applied again by the test before it compares); the four study refusals and the tenant-wide 429 are what the gateway's app ANSWERED when played in-process on a throw-away database (a tenant with a neutral name, set with the values of § 2 of the page: study etude-pilote-2027, audit_required, expires 2027-04-30, max_users_day 5; sixth identity of the day for user_limit_reached; clock set after the end date for the 410). `headers` holds, of each answer, x-sokkan-error, x-should-retry and retry-after WHEN SENT: since study-no-retry the four study refusals carry `x-should-retry: false`, the tenant-wide 429 carries none of the three. Regenerate with the script, never by hand; tests/test_pilot_integration.py compares this file with the checkout when one is at hand (SOKKAN_CLOUD_SRC, else /root/sokkan-cloud).
